dedupe_keys.name: bdot10k poland s topographic objects database 1 10 000

description: BDOT10k (Baza Danych Obiektów Topograficznych) is Poland's national vector database of topographic objects, with content and detail equivalent to a 1:10,000 topographic map. It records the location and attributes of the water network, transport network, utility networks (sieci uzbrojenia terenu), land cover, buildings, structures and facilities, land use complexes, protected areas and administrative units. The integrated national copy is coordinated by GUGiK, with data produced and kept current together with regional authorities. It is available free through web services, a WMTS and WMS view service and a download service on geoportal.gov.pl, listed on the national open data portal under CC BY 4.0; as part of the state geodetic resource it may be used without restriction, with a required source statement. Caveats: update dates differ between regions, and utility network detail is limited to what topographic mapping captures. It gives a national multi-sector asset and land use base for exposure and network analyses in Poland; a related record is the Poland ISOK flood hazard maps.
